falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 4% above its current 20-day closing high within 14 days, and on that same close the NYSE cumulative advance-decline line is also at a new 20-day high
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breadth-confirmed upside breakout falsifies both the mini_top_2019_jun analog and UNKNOWN/HOLD: the phase was continuation, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 6% below today's close within 14 days, with VIX closing above 28 on the same session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A volatility-confirmed drawdown falsifies UNKNOWN/HOLD: the 75% mini-top match was already a sell, and the phase was distribution rather than unknown.

falsification_conditions.condition: US 10-year Treasury yield moves at least 35 basis points from today's close within 14 days, and investment-grade credit OAS moves at least 15 basis points in the same risk direction over that window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A joint rates-and-credit regime break makes the macro phase identifiable, so UNKNOWN and a passive HOLD were the wrong call.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
